339-574-677-8201.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-8201.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2577-5670-7452.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-7452.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

3968-4050-4078-4616.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-4616.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Moldervine Reclamation triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card for each trigger.
Repeat.

643-3899-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-3899-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat from step 3.

997-3197-8181.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature, causing you to scry 1
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4365-6753-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Mondrak and Exalted Sunborn.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
4365-6753-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

430-2743-6222-7824.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-2743-6222-7824.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least four token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Bard.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

2099-2626-4986--44.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2348-3430-4019--85.easyPrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that can add {U}.
2348-3430-4019--85.description:
Play any land that taps for {U}.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding three mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.

280-1479-3604.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Cadric (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

475-1274-3263-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1274-3263-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

140-6735-7433.description:
Activate Soul Channeling by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

774-1671-6664.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Simic Growth Chamber's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2533-3388-6913.notablePrerequisites: One of the two Clones must be on the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers, with the other in your graveyard.
2533-3388-6913.description:
Activate the clone of Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the other clone from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

804-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
804-7009-7068.description:
Activate Sakashima the Impostor using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Sakashima
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning Sakashima from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1170-1329-2608-3200.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Urza's Bauble.
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1170-5078-6747-6979.easyPrerequisites:
You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
You control an artifact.
1170-5078-6747-6979.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-3693-5224-6967.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-2511-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2511-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2511-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

2792-3647-4125.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2792-3647-4125.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Great Whale
When Shipwreck Dowser and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2792-3647-4125.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

804-5756-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1818-2530-2577-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
1818-2530-2577-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

3054-3220-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-3220-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-2043-4365-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

116-4865-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Vesuvan Shapeshifter on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Vesuvan Shapeshifter do not have summoning sickness.
116-4865-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Vesuvan Shapeshifter.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Vesuvan Shapeshifter.
Activate Vesuvan Shapeshifter by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1379-3259-4359-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
1379-3259-4359-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1379-3259-4359-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2665-2743-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2665-2743-4094.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1636-2527-4659-5489-5490.notablePrerequisites:
Zellix does not have summoning sickness.
Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2527-4659-5489-5490.description:
Activate Zellix by paying {1} and tapping it.
Haunted One triggers, causing all Horrors you control to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Zellix ability, causing a player to mill three cards.
If the player milled a creature card this way, Zellix triggers, creating a 1/1 Horror creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Pith Driller, adding {C}{C}.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Pith Driller trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

338-678-2060-2123-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
You have at least two opponents.
338-678-2060-2123-5256.description:
Cast Kokusho by paying {4}{B}{B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kokusho.
When Kokusho dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Kokusho trigger, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Kokusho's power.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

880-2692-3875.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

678-1718-4833.description:
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

914-2232-3388-3604.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2232-3388-3604.description:
Cast Moritte by paying {2}{G}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Dockside Extortionist.
Moritte enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio and Cadric.
Resolve the Moritte trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Moritte that enters as a copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
The Moritte token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Moritte trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Moritte from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}{U}{U}.
 Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may instead have Moritte copy any other nonlegendary creature you control.

1215-2034-2834-4763.notablePrerequisites: Hero's Blade attached to Hope of Ghirapur.
1215-2034-2834-4763.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hope of Ghirapur, adding {C}{C}.
Hope of Ghirapur dies, triggering Koll, returning Hope of Ghirapur from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Hope of Ghirapur by paying {1}.
Hope of Ghirapur enters the battlefield, triggering Hero's Blade, attaching Hero's Blade to Hope of Ghirapur.
Repeat.

1613-2050-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
Verdant Haven attached to a Forest you control.
1613-2050-3525.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
